用户手册

1.该工作流程使用Qwen-Image-Edit-Rapid-AIO进行图像编辑，支持单图、双图和三图编辑，或从单图生成故事板。

2.对于情节提要的使用，启用切换并手动连接提示。只需修改生成的故事板帧数和情节，即可通过 Qwen3VL 推理生成故事板。使用Qwen3VL模型时，建议使用8B参数版本以获得更好的性能。 Gemini 或 Gork 也可用于生成故事板提示以获得最佳结果。

3.对于多图像使用，启用切换并根据需要选择相关选项。

4.根据您的需求启用高清和人脸修复功能。

5.使用最新版本的Qwen-Image-Edit-Rapid-AIO模型进行编辑。该模型人性化程度很高，但不同版本之间存在明显差异；您可以根据您的具体需求下载并使用合适的版本。

6.包含两个LoRA，可以根据需要启用。 F2P 显着增强了面部一致性，但可能会减少面部表情和可用角度的多样性。测试表明，MCNL的NSFW特性与AIO模型兼容，为NSFW内容生成提供更好的支持。

7.参数选择区允许分辨率控制。

8.根据您的具体需要调整所有其他参数。

User Manual

1.This workflow uses Qwen-Image-Edit-Rapid-AIO for image editing, supporting single-image, dual-image and triple-image editing, or generating storyboards from a single image.

2.For storyboard usage, enable the toggle and manually connect the prompts. Storyboards can be generated via Qwen3VL inference by simply modifying the number of generated storyboard frames and the plot. When using the Qwen3VL model, the 8B parameter version is recommended for better performance. Gemini or Gork can also be used to generate storyboard prompts for optimal results.

3.For multi-image usage, enable the toggle and select the relevant option as needed.

4.Enable the HD and face restoration features according to your requirements.

5.The latest version of the Qwen-Image-Edit-Rapid-AIO model is used for editing. This model is highly user-friendly, yet there are noticeable differences between different versions; you can download and use the appropriate version based on your specific needs.

6.Two LoRAs are included and can be enabled as required. F2P enhances facial consistency significantly but may reduce the diversity of facial expressions and available angles. Tests have shown that the NSFW feature of MCNL is compatible with the AIO model, providing better support for NSFW content generation.

7.The Parameter Selection Area allows for resolution control.

8.Adjust all other parameters according to your specific needs.

This workflow is available for free online testing—download it for local use only if it meets your needs.
